slides.text: Human in the loop A workflow where AI chats do the jobs and you steer: each stage, its handoff and its check.

Why · How · What Hand AI a big job and it comes back looking right: why you stay in the loop, how, and a workflow to try. Why The AI hands back a result that looks right and is not. Lawyers once filed a brief citing six cases ChatGPT had invented. ( ) It looked right, and nobody checked. How Split the job into stages and check each one. Break the task into steps, write the requirements down, let the AI ask before it starts, and review every step, not only the end. ( ) What A workflow where AI chats do the jobs and you steer. Each stage copies a prompt for a fresh chat, and you check its result before the next stage. ( ) Try the project plan below.

Human in the loop workflow The project-plan workflow: six stages from a vague task to a reviewed report, a fresh chat for each job, and you check every artifact in between. About Unchecked output has cost real money In a New York federal case, lawyers filed a brief citing six cases ChatGPT had invented and were fined; the court held that rules give attorneys a gatekeeping role for the accuracy of their filings 1 . In one study, programmers with an AI assistant wrote less secure code and were more sure it was secure, a result a larger study disputes 2 (research AIE-0005, AIE-0010). Sources (2) Judge P. Kevin Castel, Mata v. Avianca, Inc., Opinion and Order, No. 22-cv-1461 (S.D.N.Y. June 22, 2023) ( opens in a new tab ) storage.courtlistener.com Perry et al., Do Users Write More Insecure Code with AI Assistants? ( opens in a new tab ) arxiv.org Small steps, stated needs, step checks Models often solve each sub-problem yet fail to compose them, and decomposing helps 1 . A stated requirement is met more steadily than a guessed one 2 . Clarifying questions raise accuracy on underspecified tasks 3 . Step-level checks catch flaws that a check of the final answer passes 4 (research AIE-0007, AIE-0008, AIE-0009, AIE-0010). Sources (4) Zhou et al., Least-to-Most Prompting Enables Complex Reasoning in Large Language Models ( opens in a new tab ) arxiv.org Yang et al., What Prompts Don't Say: Understanding and Managing Underspecification in LLM Prompts ( opens in a new tab ) arxiv.org Vijayvargiya et al., Ambig-SWE: Interactive Agents to Overcome Underspecificity in Software Engineering ( opens in a new tab ) arxiv.org Lightman et al., Let's Verify Step by Step ( opens in a new tab ) arxiv.org Fresh chat per stage, checked in between Accuracy falls as a chat grows, and a model that took a wrong turn leans on its earlier answers, so a fresh, focused context per job helps 1 ; the answer to a step can be right while the reasoning is wrong, so an outside reader checks each artifact 2 (research AIE-0011, AIE-0010). Sources (2) Laban et al., LLMs Get Lost In Multi-Turn Conversation ( opens in a new tab ) arxiv.org Lightman et al., Let's Verify Step by Step ( opens in a new tab ) arxiv.org
